notes: VAT standard rate 15.5% (ZIMRA; raised from 15% on 1 Jan 2026). Gold bullion is zero-rated ONLY when supplied to the Reserve Bank or a registered bank (VAT Act s.10(1)(f)); retail bullion takes 15.5%. Gold is absent from the s.11 exempt list. Import duty HS 7108 null (no openable ZIMRA tariff line).

sources.name: Zimbabwe Revenue Authority (zimra.co.zw) - Mechanics of VAT
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the standard VAT rate is 15.5% and all goods are standard rated unless specifically exempted or zero-rated

sources.name: Zimbabwe Revenue Authority (zimra.co.zw) - Value Added Tax Act [Chapter 23:12], s.10
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: s.10(1)(f) zero-rates only gold supplied to the Reserve Bank or a registered bank, in bar/ingot and similar refined forms
sources.quote: the supply is to the Reserve Bank, or any bank registered under the Banking Act [Chapter 24:20], of gold in the form of bars, blank coins, ingots, buttons, wire, plate or granules or in solution
